fields.description: After a worker enters their PIN, the kiosk returns to the name screen if nobody touches it for this long. 20 to 600.
fields.label: Auto Sign-out After (seconds of no touch)

fields.description: When ticked, a worker cannot sign in unless the tablet camera captures their photo. Recommended once you've confirmed the camera works on your tablet.
fields.label: Require Photo at Every Sign-in

fields.description: When unticked, only a Timesheet Manager can add manual entries or change/delete time entries on the kiosk.
fields.label: Allow Workers to Add / Edit / Delete Entries

fields.description: Stops a worker from starting a new timer while one is still running on another WIH (prevents double-counting when someone forgets to stop).
fields.label: Only One Running Timer per Worker
Use Face Check for Workers with a Registered Face

fields.description: Strict = fewer wrong matches but more 'not recognised'. Start with Normal.
fields.label: Face Match Strictness
Ask Worker to Blink (stops photos being held up)

fields.description: Every PIN sign-in is marked 'PIN' in Kiosk Punch Log so supervisors can review it. Timesheet Managers can always use their PIN.
fields.label: Allow PIN if Face Check Fails
Failed Face Checks Before Face Lock
